name: Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) — licensing + conduct
reference: Cap. 571 + SFC Code of Conduct + SFC Guidelines

chapters.title: SFC Code of Conduct general principles

articles.title: Regulated activities Type 1-7
articles.requirement: Type 1: dealing in securities; Type 2: dealing in futures contracts; Type 3: leveraged FX trading; Type 4: advising on securities; Type 5: advising on futures contracts; Type 6: advising on corporate finance; Type 7: providing automated trading services (ATS) — captures security-token + certain crypto trading platforms. Persons carrying on any regulated activity in HK or to HK clients require SFC licensing or authorisation.

articles.title: Regulated activities Type 8-12 + Type VA
articles.requirement: Type 8: securities margin financing; Type 9: asset management; Type 10: credit-rating services; Type 11 + 12: OTC derivatives (designated). Type VA (via AMLO Schedule 3B, June 2023): VATP services — operating a centralised virtual asset trading platform. Cross-type licensing common (e.g. asset manager dealing in securities for own funds — Type 1 + Type 9).

articles.title: SFC Code of Conduct General Principles
articles.requirement: Ten General Principles: GP1 honesty + fairness; GP2 diligence; GP3 capabilities; GP4 information about clients; GP5 information for clients (clear + balanced + not misleading); GP6 conflicts of interest; GP7 compliance with laws; GP8 client assets (proper safekeeping); GP9 responsibility of senior management; GP10 management, supervision + internal control. Mandatory baseline for all SFC-licensed persons.

articles.title: SFC Suitability + KYC
articles.requirement: Know-Your-Client requirements (paragraph 5.1): client identification + financial situation + investment experience + objectives. Suitability requirement (paragraph 5.2): recommend only investments suitable for the client's circumstances + reasonable basis. Strict-liability misrepresentation rule per 2017 Lufax decision. Suitability assessment + records retained for review.

articles.title: Market misconduct + insider dealing (Parts XIII + XIV)
articles.requirement: Six market misconduct offences (Part XIII civil + Part XIV criminal): insider dealing; false trading; price rigging; disclosure of false or misleading information inducing transactions; stock market manipulation; disclosure of information about prohibited transactions. Market Misconduct Tribunal (civil) + criminal courts. SFC investigation + enforcement powers; cooperation with HK Police + ICAC.

articles.title: SFC AML/CFT Guideline (sectoral)
articles.requirement: SFC's sectoral AML/CFT guideline for licensed corporations + Type VA VATPs. Aligned with AMLO Schedule 2 + tailored for capital-markets + VA risks. CDD + EDD + PEPs + ongoing monitoring + STR + sanctions + tipping-off + record-keeping. Periodic updates (most recently 2024 for VATP enhancements).

articles.title: SFC Fund Manager Code of Conduct
articles.section: SFC Fund Manager Code of Conduct
articles.requirement: Fund management-specific conduct + governance + risk-management + valuation + liquidity + custody + investor-disclosure obligations. Applies to Type 9 licensees managing collective investment schemes + discretionary portfolios. Sustainability disclosures aligned with global standards from 2022 onwards.

articles.title: SFC VATP Guidelines + Code of Conduct adaptations
articles.requirement: Detailed conduct + custody + AML + market-conduct + token-listing + retail-investor-protection obligations for licensed VATPs. Custody: 98%+ cold-wallet for customer assets; multi-party computation / multi-sig controls; insurance over hot wallet. Token listing: SFC approval for retail-permitted tokens; due-diligence requirements. Market conduct: anti-manipulation surveillance + reporting; fair-pricing standards.

articles.title: SFC client-asset custody (general)
articles.section: SFC Securities + Futures (Client Securities) Rules + Custody Guidelines
articles.requirement: Client-asset segregation from licensee's own holdings; specific custody account requirements with authorised institutions; client-money rules (Client Money Rules under SFO); periodic reconciliation; client-asset insurance / indemnity. Distinct from VATP-specific custody but with similar substantive protection principles.

articles.title: SFC enforcement framework
articles.requirement: SFC powers: licence suspension or revocation; revocation of approved person status; CMPs; prohibition orders against individuals; remediation + restitution orders; criminal-referral for criminal-tier offences. Active enforcement track record — published case decisions + Enforcement Reporter quarterly. Coordination with HKMA + ICAC + HK Police + Customs + foreign regulators.
